none: PAS NLM-A28B41: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Constantine II (317-340), Camp Gate issue of 324-330, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS[---]. Reverse description: Camp gate with two towers, star above. Legend appears deliberately removed. Reverse inscription: probably [PROVIDENTIAE CAESS]. Diameter: 19.1mm,…
